purpose: one bounded same-stack task-bearing authorized certificate-granularity experiment; not F8 repair
selection: Ascending SHA256(seed:canonical source), capacity only. Exclude all prior sources and six reserved but unused previous validation sources. No outcome/gold-position source replacement.
input: Existing structure-preserving-window-v2, common16K, full question and original whitespace, gold-independent optional-context head-tail packing.
serving_scenario: Authorized workspace repeatedly serves a fixed registered FAQ question with stable retrieved documents to registered tenants. Same original service-quality neutral per-request tenant/turn tool metadata. Controlled task-bearing service, not production trace; exact repeated-question frequency is declared, not measured.
production_claim_boundary: Finite prospective-qualified deployment protocol. Compiled self-path attestation is NOT Raw equivalence or arbitrary future input certification; actual Raw/compiled task outputs are audited independently.
layout: Frozen L3 only, original legal CALC ladder; no level scan, no clean renderer, no scope/margin tuning

attestation.reference: same canonical representative compiled prompt tenant00 turn0 for both Session and Template
attestation.reference_namespace: controller-private per template, separate from all business/shared state; cacheable across registrations for BOTH scopes
attestation.shared_publication: Only verifier PASS may publish block-aligned stable prefix

cache_identity: Identical authorized template namespace across Raw/Session/Template businesses; certificate granularity never changes cache salt group. Reference canary remains controller-private.
qualification: Per model, both blind development sources must pass fixed L3 deployment attestation; all12 paired Raw/candidate request points complete and no task-score drop >.03; each source candidate mean >=Raw mean; at least one source has Raw score>0. All signed scope/authorization/PSTP/Prompt-ID checks pass. No replacement or relaxed gate. If zero models qualify stop.

formal.models: Only development-qualified models, all others retained NO-GO
formal.epoch: cold service start includes source preparation, attestation reference generation, HTTP verification, bindings and failures; arrivals tied to the same global start before registration
formal.rotation: Latin-square Raw/Session/Template order by repeat; paired repeat sources/arrivals/seed fixed
metrics: planned-arrival Mean/P95/P99 TTFT and end-to-end latency
absolute SLO Goodput and compliant fraction
full direct wall and achieved throughput auxiliary
all-route output IDs/finish and task score up/down/neutral
formal.statistics: Per-source and repeat rows, source-cluster bootstrap plus leave-one-source sensitivity; no pooled-requests independence or significance promised

raw_only_calibration.load_rule: lambda = 0.9 * (completed / measured batch wall after common setup), single frozen Poisson load; no Contract output used
raw_only_calibration.SLO_rule: ceil(1.5 * Raw request TTFT p95 / 500ms)*500ms; max minimum 1500ms; E2E analogous; freeze before formal outcome

stop: No viable development model -> archive NO-GO. Formal negative outcomes remain final; no adaptive source/level/load/SLO changes. No new GPU branch beyond declared cells.
